description: Frontend design and UX tooling for Claude Code — a design pipeline that sequences concept derivation, build rules, and verification gates, with a live-browser design reviewer.

plugins.description: Design and redesign frontend surfaces with a directed pipeline: concept derivation, a committed direction contract, category-canon builds, and mechanical verification (axe accessibility, mobile overflow, screenshot sweeps, anti-slop detection). Includes a live-browser design-review subagent and wiring for external component registries.
